name: live-fixture
description: The minimal native dsh plugin used as the SUBJECT of the live add/remove demonstration: one tool ('fixture ping'). Deliberately NOT part of the workstation boot roster - it is added to the running service by 'plugin add' and disposed again by 'plugin remove'

label.description: Marker echoed back by 'fixture ping' (default 'live-fixture'), so a caller can tell which row answered.
